top_signals.title: Tankers Are Being Hit Daily. So Why Is Oil Falling?
top_signals.summary: Brent tumbled 5% to $91 this week, as recovering Gulf oil flows outweigh tanker attacks, Houthi threats and escalating geopolitical tensions.
